range: rank 133-141 minus rank 132 (excluded: P585 1600 contradicts the 1614 articles)

entries.summaryZh: 1614年11月26日，大坂冬之阵期间，上杉景胜率德川方军队进攻大坂城东北鴫野村的丰臣方阵地。丰臣方由井上赖次率两千人据三重栅栏防守，栅栏被攻破，井上阵亡。大野治长率一万两千人来援并反击，上杉方以铁炮齐射稳住阵脚，丰臣军最终撤回大坂城。
entries.summaryEn: On 26 November 1614, during the winter campaign of the Siege of Osaka, Uesugi Kagekatsu's Tokugawa force attacked the Toyotomi position at Shigino village north-east of Osaka Castle. The defenders under Inoue Yoritsugu held three lines of fences with two thousand men but were overrun and their commander killed. A relief force under Ono Harunaga counter-attacked before withdrawing.
entries.significanceZh: 鴫野之战与今福之战同日发生，是大坂冬之阵初期德川方压制大坂外围据点的关键交战。
entries.significanceEn: Fought on the same day as Imafuku, Shigino was an early Tokugawa success in clearing the approaches to Osaka Castle.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基与英文维基均系于1614年11月26日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 26 November 1614; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1972年5月，越南战争复活节攻势期间，越南人民军与越共三个师进攻西原重镇昆嵩，企图打通通往中部沿海的通道。南越军队在美国顾问与空中火力支援下坚守，双方在城市外围激战数周，北越军伤亡重大后撤围。昆嵩得以保全，成为南越在1972年少数守住的省会之一。
entries.summaryEn: In May 1972, during the Easter Offensive of the Vietnam War, three North Vietnamese and Viet Cong divisions attacked Kontum in the Central Highlands to open a route to the coast. South Vietnamese forces, supported by American advisers and heavy air power, held the town through weeks of fighting and the attackers withdrew with heavy losses.
entries.significanceZh: 昆嵩战役挫败了北越1972年攻势中打通西原走廊的企图，是南越在复活节攻势中少数成功的防御战。
entries.significanceEn: Kontum frustrated the North Vietnamese attempt to open the Central Highlands corridor and was one of the few successful South Vietnamese defences of the 1972 offensive.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记5月26日至27日，英文维基把昆嵩之战视为1972年整场攻势；本条以P585的1972年为准并保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia gives 26-27 May while English Wikipedia treats the battle as the wider 1972 campaign; the entry follows P585 with the year 1972 at year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元23年6月至7月，绿林军建立的更始政权在昆阳（今河南叶县）以少胜多，击破王莽新朝主力。刘秀率数千援军突入敌阵，新军主帅王寻被杀，大军溃散。此役摧毁了新朝赖以支撑的军事力量，同年绿林军攻入长安，新莽覆亡，刘秀日后建立东汉。
entries.summaryEn: In June and July of 23 CE the Lulin army of the Gengshi regime, outnumbered many times over, broke the main Xin dynasty force at Kunyang in present-day Henan. Liu Xiu led a small relief column into the enemy camp, Wang Xun was killed and the Xin army collapsed; the defeat destroyed the dynasty's military power.
entries.significanceZh: 昆阳之战是中国古代以少胜多的著名战例，直接导致新莽王朝覆灭，刘秀由此崛起。
entries.significanceEn: Kunyang is a classic Chinese example of victory against overwhelming odds; it destroyed the Xin dynasty and launched Liu Xiu's rise.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均记公元23年6月至7月；公元纪年不存在0年问题，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to June and July of 23 CE; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1805年10月18日，马塞纳率法军在维罗纳附近强渡阿迪杰河，击退卡尔大公部将武卡索维奇所部，在东岸建立桥头堡。此役属第三次反法同盟战争，法军的目的是牵制意大利境内的奥军，配合拿破仑在德意志的作战，也为随后10月底的卡尔迪耶罗之战创造了条件。
entries.summaryEn: On 18 October 1805 Massena's French troops crossed the Adige near Verona, drove back the Austrian defenders under Vukassovich and established a bridgehead on the east bank. The action was part of the War of the Third Coalition and was meant to pin Archduke Charles's army in Italy while Napoleon campaigned in Germany.
entries.significanceZh: 维罗纳之战为法军在阿迪杰河东岸取得桥头堡，实现了牵制意大利战场奥军的战略目的。
entries.significanceEn: Verona gave the French a bridgehead over the Adige and tied down the Austrian army in Italy as intended.
entries.notesZh: 维罗纳在249、312、402、489、1799与1805年都有同名战事，本条专指1805年之战；英文维基同名页为消歧义页。
entries.notesEn: Verona saw fighting in 249, 312, 402, 489, 1799 and 1805; this entry is the 1805 action and the English title is a disambiguation page.

entries.summaryZh: 1995年5月27日，波斯尼亚战争期间，塞族共和国军占领萨拉热窝弗尔巴尼亚桥两端法国维和部队的观察哨，扣押12名法国军人，其中两人被留在桥上充当人盾。勒库安特上尉率30人反击夺回哨位，法军2人阵亡、十余人受伤，塞族方面4人死亡、4人被俘。此后塞军基本不再与城内法军交火。
entries.summaryEn: On 27 May 1995, during the Bosnian War, Bosnian Serb forces seized the French UN observation posts at both ends of Sarajevo's Vrbanja Bridge and took twelve peacekeepers hostage, keeping two on the bridge as human shields. A platoon of thirty French soldiers under Captain Francois Lecointre retook the posts.
entries.significanceZh: 弗尔巴尼亚桥之战是联合国维和部队少有的主动使用武力案例，改变了萨拉热窝城内塞族武装与维和部队的对峙态势。
entries.significanceEn: Vrbanja Bridge was a rare case of UN peacekeepers using force and it changed the stand-off between Serb forces and UNPROFOR inside Sarajevo.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1995年5月27日；另有一名法军伤者事后不治，本条按当日战果记两人阵亡。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the action to 27 May 1995; a third French soldier died of his wounds later and the entry records the two killed in the fighting.

entries.summaryZh: 2023年11月2日，以色列国防军在加沙战争中完成对加沙市的合围，战斗自10月30日起在城郊展开。加沙市是加沙地带人口最多的城市，乐施会称约50万巴勒斯坦人与200名以色列人及其他人质被困在加沙北部。围城持续至2025年1月停火，哈马斯仍控制加沙市。
entries.summaryEn: On 2 November 2023 the Israel Defense Forces completed the encirclement of Gaza City during the Gaza war, after fighting on the outskirts began on 30 October. Gaza City is the most populous city in the Strip; Oxfam reported that about 500,000 Palestinians and 200 Israelis and other captives were trapped in northern Gaza.
entries.significanceZh: 加沙围城战是2023年加沙战争中以军控制加沙北部核心城区的关键行动，造成了大规模平民流离与人道危机。
entries.significanceEn: The siege of Gaza City was the key operation through which Israel took control of the northern Strip and it produced large-scale civilian displacement and a humanitarian crisis.
entries.notesZh: 维基数据P585记2023年，围城实际延续至2025年1月停火；本条按来源取2023年，并在正文说明后续。
entries.notesEn: Wikidata P585 records 2023 while the siege in fact continued until the January 2025 ceasefire; the entry follows the source year and states the later end in the text.

entries.summaryZh: 1557年4月30日黎明，西班牙总督比利亚格拉率军突袭马普切领袖莱夫扎茹设在马塔基托河畔树林间的营寨。此前莱夫扎茹曾击杀前任总督瓦尔迪维亚并进逼圣地亚哥。西班牙军夜袭得手，莱夫扎茹战死，马普切人对圣地亚哥的威胁解除，阿劳卡尼亚战争进入新的阶段。
entries.summaryEn: At dawn on 30 April 1557 the Spanish governor Francisco de Villagra surprised the fortified camp of the Mapuche toqui Lautaro between a wooded hill and the Mataquito River. Lautaro, who had killed the former governor Pedro de Valdivia and threatened Santiago, was killed in the attack, ending Mapuche designs on the Spanish capital.
entries.significanceZh: 马塔基托之战击杀了马普切领袖莱夫扎茹，解除了马普切人对圣地亚哥的威胁，也报了瓦尔迪维亚阵亡之仇。
entries.significanceEn: Mataquito killed Lautaro, ended the Mapuche threat to Santiago and avenged the death of Pedro de Valdivia.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1557年4月30日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 30 April 1557; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1589年7月17日，伊达政宗率军在陆奥国折上原（今福岛县猪苗代与磐梯一带）与芦名义广、佐竹义重联军交战。伊达军击破对手，芦名氏灭亡，政宗由此控制南陆奥大部，为日后称雄东北奠定基础。此役是伊达氏扩张过程中最关键的会战之一，也是战国后期东北势力重组的标志。
entries.summaryEn: On 17 July 1589 Date Masamune defeated the allied forces of Ashina Yoshihiro and Satake Yoshishige at Suriagehara in Mutsu Province, in what is now Fukushima Prefecture. The Ashina house was destroyed and Date took control of most of southern Mutsu, laying the base for his dominance of the north-east.
entries.significanceZh: 折上原之战消灭芦名氏，使伊达政宗一举控制南陆奥，是其在东北扩张的决定性会战。
entries.significanceEn: Suriagehara destroyed the Ashina and gave Date Masamune control of southern Mutsu, deciding his expansion in the north-east.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1589年7月17日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 17 July 1589; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1990年8月2日，伊拉克入侵科威特当天，伊军特种部队乘直升机突袭科威特东北的菲拉卡岛，与岛上科威特守军交战。守军包括一个步兵连、一个边防连和一个装备鹰式防空导弹的防空连，最终伊军占领全岛。岛上居民多已在入侵前撤离，此役是伊拉克吞并科威特行动的一部分。
entries.summaryEn: On 2 August 1990, the day of the invasion of Kuwait, Iraqi special forces flew by helicopter to attack Failaka Island north-east of Kuwait City. The garrison of an infantry company, a border guard company and an air defence company armed with Hawk missiles was overcome and the island occupied; most residents had already left.
entries.significanceZh: 菲拉卡岛之战是伊拉克入侵科威特当日的组成部分，使伊军控制了科威特的海上门户。
entries.significanceEn: Failaka was part of the invasion day itself and gave Iraq control of Kuwait's offshore approaches.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1990年8月2日；双方兵力数字来自战后记述，本条不采信单一伤亡数字。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 2 August 1990; the troop figures come from later accounts and the entry adopts no single casualty count.
